name: SAM 3.1 (Object Multiplex)
notes: Drop-in checkpoint upgrade; 7x faster multi-object tracking; Comfy-Org/sam3.1 packaging ready; same node API — swap checkpoint path only. Non-commercial gated license on HF.

name: ReActor Core (no-InsightFace rebuild)
notes: Drops hard C++ InsightFace build dependency; pure-Python face analyser; adds Face Similarity QA node + GPEN-1024/2048 support; 10x video frame analysis speedup. CPU-only HF Space created 2026-06-01 confirms momentum.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 (ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR2-3B)
notes: 60% less VRAM vs v1.x; 2-3x faster; adaptive window attention; GGUF quantized (cmeka/SeedVR2-GGUF) for 16 GB headroom; ICLR 2026 validated. ComfyUI wrapper: github.com/numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler.

name: nvidia/PiD (Pixel Diffusion Decoder)
notes: Unified latent-decode + 4x/8x SR in one pass; 6x lower latency vs cascaded pipeline; staged VRAM-offload mode; NVIDIA Research. Community ComfyUI-PiD node: github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD appeared ~2026-06-02. Novel architecture — workflow-breaking vs current VAE->SR cascade.

name: Ideogram 4.0 (ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-nf4)
notes: 9.3B DiT; structured JSON bounding-box/palette prompting; native 2K output; best-in-class text rendering; non-commercial license; day-0 ComfyUI support via Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 (updated 2026-06-05). NF4 variant fits 16 GB budget.

name: LBM Relighting (ComfyUI-LBM, 1038lab)
notes: Single-step Latent Bridge Matching relighting. Additive: faster than IC-Light for product/object lighting compositing. IC-Light remains better for environmental/ambient relighting. Actively maintained by 1038lab.

name: BFS Best Face Swap Video (LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA)
notes: Temporal video face/head-swap on LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA. Novel: high-noise timestep distribution + latent identity injection per frame. ComfyUI PR #13111 (March 2026) merged for IC-LoRA support. Use Alissonerdx canonical variant only — zero-download clones have uncertain provenance.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI)
notes: RTX Tensor Core-accelerated 4x upscale; 4K output; ~30x faster than software SR; negligible VRAM overhead. RTX 5060 Ti supported. Additive optional fast path for build_video_upscale.

name: FLUX.1 Kontext [dev]
notes: BLOCKED: ~20 GB FP8 exceeds 16 GB VRAM budget. 12B unified gen+editing; iterative in-context edits; KontextBench SOTA. Watch for GGUF Q4 variant that fits 12-14 GB.

name: Wan 2.7
notes: BLOCKED: 14B+ MoE, ~20-24 GB full precision; Partner Node gating for local use. Native 60fps; FLF; 9-grid multi-ref; 5000-char prompt; audio reference; Apache 2.0. Watch for GGUF community weights + native (non-Partner) ComfyUI node.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (8.3B)
notes: BLOCKED: VRAM borderline 16-20 GB FP8. 8.3B (vs 13B); FP8; 75s on 4090; I2V step-distilled (8/12 steps). Watch for community confirmation that FP8 + offload fits RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0
notes: BLOCKED: Partner Nodes API-based only; local weights timeline unclear. Better geometry/material vs 2.x; text-to-3D + multi-view I-to-3D. Watch for local weights release on github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2.

name: HyperSwap 1c (FaceFusion Labs)
notes: BLOCKED: ReActor integration issue #143 not yet merged. HyperSwap 1c replaces inswapper_128 with higher realism ONNX models. Watch for PR merge into Gourieff/ComfyUI-ReActor.

name: facerestore_advanced (flickleafy)
notes: Adds IQA gating (skips CodeFormer on already-clean faces), multi-metric analysis (SSIM, artifact detection), model fallback system, intelligent caching. Less battle-tested than mav-rik/facerestore_cf. Watch for stable release tag.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration — winning team methods
notes: CVPRW workshop was yesterday. Winning team methods use AdaFace ID-consistency + GAN+diffusion hybrid. Code/weights not yet public. Watch github.com/jkwang28/NTIRE2026_RealWorld_Face_Restoration for releases (expected 1-4 weeks).

name: Microsoft MAI-Image-2.5 / MAI-Image-2.5-Flash
notes: BLOCKED: API-only (Azure Foundry, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI). No local weights. Proprietary. Worth monitoring for potential open-weight release.

name: Wan 3.0 (60B)
release_date: 2026-Q2 (expected; official HF org not yet updated)
notes: BLOCKED: 60B model almost certainly requires multi-GPU or very heavy quantization for RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Open weights unconfirmed — multiple third-party sources reference it but Wan-AI HF org shows no Wan 3.0 repo yet. Treat as 'on watch'.

name: Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance, API)
notes: BLOCKED: API-only; no local weights; credential dependency. Multi-modal: up to 9 images + 3 video clips + 3 audio files -> synchronized audio-video. Monitor for open-weight release.

name: SPANV2 (NTIRE 2026 Efficient SR winner)
notes: BLOCKED: No unified HF checkpoint yet — challenge just closed. 0.139M param pure-CNN; wins NTIRE 2026 'shortest runtime' track; <4 GB. Lightweight candidate to replace 4x-UltraSharp in latency-sensitive nodes once checkpoint published.

name: ComfyUI v0.22.0 LTX enhancements (attention_mask, downscale_ratio_temporal)
notes: Infrastructure-only (no new model weights). Adds optional attention_mask input for LTX video control; downscale_ratio_temporal for processing; peak VRAM reduction with guide_mask. Additive: consider exposing guide_mask param in build_ltx_video.

name: BiRefNet official ComfyUI node (no new model weights)
notes: Official ComfyUI node for BiRefNet; no new model weights (RMBG-2.0 minor update Apr 6 2026 — same model). Integration cleanliness improvement; existing community nodes are compatible.
